name: DarkIris Inc. Class A Ordinary Shares
summary: Darkiris Inc., operating through its subsidiaries, is primarily engaged in the comprehensive development, publishing, marketing, and distribution of mobile games across various platforms. Its market footprint spans Hong Kong, Taiwan, Southeast Asia, North America, and the Middle East. The company internally handles all aspects of game creation, including design, programming, and graphic development. Additionally, Darkiris innovates in the realm of AI interactive experiences and cross-media content applications. Its products are made available to consumers via numerous third-party digital storefronts. Established in 2017, Darkiris Inc. is headquartered in Sheung Wan, Hong Kong.
